decisions.reason: It supports the firm's core promise of trusted second-channel communication for strong authentication and remains strategically important for cross-channel identity security.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly aligned with the firm's core security platform business and its dedicated product presence suggests solid strategic relevance.

The QR-code-based hardware signature token fits regulated high-assurance signing use cases and leverages the firm's hardware and cryptography capabilities in a way that supports its move into secure digital signing ecosystems.

The payment network security compliance suite appears more niche and less central to the firm's broader identity and mobile security roadmap, so resources are better shifted to more scalable core offerings.
